#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=ec_p7_strict
#SBATCH --partition=hpxg
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=4
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=1
#SBATCH --time=04:00:00
#SBATCH --array=0-0
#SBATCH --output=slurm-%A_%a.out
set -euo pipefail
module load openmpi/5.0
source "$HOME/project/soft/orca/env.sh"
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
test "${SLURM_NTASKS}" = 4
cd "${SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR}"
sha256sum -c PACKAGE_SHA256SUMS
task=$(sed -n "$((SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID + 1))p" batch_1.txt)
test -n "$task"
cd "$task"
sha256sum -c inputs.sha256
mkdir -p attempts
run_dir="attempts/${SLURM_ARRAY_JOB_ID}_${SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID}_${SLURM_RESTART_COUNT:-0}"
mkdir "$run_dir"
cp geom.xyz job_opt.inp job_freq.inp "$run_dir/"
cd "$run_dir"
mkdir mpi_tmp
export TMPDIR="$PWD/mpi_tmp"
export PRTE_MCA_prte_tmpdir_base="$TMPDIR"
export PMIX_MCA_pmix_tmpdir_base="$TMPDIR"
python3 "${SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR}/stage_driver.py" --attempt "$PWD" --orca "$ORCA_DIR/orca"
